sps_at_hawren.accept_text: Inside Ambermill Tower, through the waygate south-east of the mill. He keeps the Archivist's Gallery, west of the reading hall.

sps_at_reagents.accept_text: Inside Ambermill Tower, through the waygate south-east of here. The Alchemy Lab is north-east of the lower hall.

sps_sfk_moonwalkers.accept_text: Shadowfang Keep, on its hill south-west of the Peril. Throughout the keep, wherever you hear chanting. Casters first.

sps_sfk_sons.accept_text: Shadowfang Keep again, south-west of here. The crypt, the armoury and the upper landing. Not in a corridor.

spn_wl_brood.turn_in_text:
Fewer legs.

That's the best thing I can say about that place right now and I've been trying to think of a second one for a week.

sps_at_helbrim.turn_in_text:
It's over, then.

Not a clean ending. But a final one, and I've come round to thinking those are different things and I only get one of them.
